result_text:
`all_files.zip` now packages the scope file lists under names derived from the configured aspect names, so renaming a scope aspect no longer breaks the export. The `reports` module compiles. I didn't run any tests, and I didn't try a renamed-aspect config.

The change is in `exportZips()` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/dataexporters/DataExporter.java`. It replaces the five hard-coded `aspect_*.txt` literals. Each scope's file name now comes from `DataExportUtils.getAspectFileListFileName(aspect, "")`, the same call that writes the loose text files. The order is unchanged: main, test, generated, build and deployment, other.

With the default config the entries are the same as before. With `buildAndDeployment` renamed, the fourth entry is `aspect_buildAndDeployment.txt`. Because the zip no longer throws, `git-history.zip` is written as well when a `git-history.txt` exists.

I left the same hard-coded names in `LandscapeAnalyzer.java:289-293` alone, since the task was about the export. They would have the same problem with a renamed aspect.
